apps.localizedDescription:
MuffinEMU is a Wii U emulator for iPhone and iPad (iOS 15 and later), built on Cemu.

- Import games from Files: WUA, decrypted games, and encrypted dumps with your own keys.txt. DLC and updates install from the app.
- Metal renderer by default, with Vulkan through MoltenVK as an option.
- Runs on the interpreter out of the box, and on the faster recompiler when a JIT enabler such as StikDebug is attached.
- An on-screen GamePad laid out from a real Wii U GamePad, with an optional analog stick, skins and a layout editor. Hardware controllers work alongside it.
- Single screen, both screens, or the TV image on an external display.
- Save states, graphic packs, and 31 app icons with matching themes.

These are unfinished test builds, published by hand to try out work in progress. Each one replaces an installed MuffinEMU: it has the same bundle identifier as the standard build, so your games, saves and settings carry over. They can crash or misbehave. For normal play use the Stable source instead. This one is the ad-hoc signed build, with the JIT entitlements embedded, for TrollStore and jailbroken devices.

Bring your own games and keys. No copyrighted content is distributed here.
